implementation_scope: ENos 6.0.0 adopted component scope; publication state is recorded by the GitHub release.
ownership_limit: Only original portions the author owns or is entitled to license receive the new grants. Specific third-party attributions, quotations, institutional material and unresolved rights remain excluded, including within mixed files.
sem02_boundary: SEM02/** retained package notice; no replacement D1 grant. This does not independently establish item ownership or the exact legal scope of the notice.

original_code.boundary: Eligible original software, configuration and code examples only.

original_teaching_mixed.boundary: CC BY 4.0 original prose/figures; MIT original code examples, scripts and styles. Quoted, institutional and third-party portions remain excluded.

original_figure.boundary: Eligible original editable diagram or rendered figure only; third-party portions retain their terms.

original_question_mixed.boundary: CC BY 4.0 original question/explanation prose; MIT original code examples and operational schema/configuration code.

original_example_fixture.boundary: Eligible original software-example fixtures only; real personal, institutional or third-party data are excluded.

historical_record.boundary: Original editorial record only. Retained quotations and historical licence/policy wording preserve their provenance and are not active replacement grants or policies.

retained_sem02_notice.boundary: SEM02 package notice and SO ASE-CSIE Team attribution retained. Exact item-level rights boundary is not independently established; no replacement grant is inferred.

upstream_package_file.boundary: Exact pinned upstream package bytes. See package licence paths and manifests; no new rights are granted here.

derived_upstream_asset.boundary: Font/theme/compiler output retains upstream component terms. Eligible original transformations may be MIT; upstream rights are not replaced.

provenance_metadata.boundary: Original explanatory record only; embedded notices and upstream data retain their provenance and terms.

licence_instrument.boundary: Licence/policy instrument: read its stated terms and scope rather than inferring a grant from this classification.

mixed_archive.boundary: Container only; members follow reviewed source paths and unmatched members remain unresolved.

unresolved.boundary: No grant inferred. Establish source and terms before assigning an original-material profile.

assets/vendor/fonts.css.scope: Combined Fontsource CSS; component terms remain applicable.

05_LECTURES/00-HTML_all_as_ZIP(again)/AL.scope: Member profiles follow source paths; this is a licensing boundary record, not source-to-archive byte verification.
